Introduction 
The National Service Scheme (NSS) Unit of VIIT, in collaboration with Unnat Bharat Abhiyan (UBA) and
the Leo Club Pune, successfully organized an E-Waste Collection Drive on 1st October 2025. The drive
aimed to create awareness about the importance of responsible disposal of e-waste and to encourage students
and faculty to contribute towards environmental sustainability. 
Event Details 
- Thebooth wasset up at 9:00 AM, and collection began at 9:30 AM.
- Posters, banners, and hoardings highlighting the NSS VIIT identity and upcoming initiatives were
displayed.
- Volunteers remained present at the booth throughout the day to guide students and faculty regarding the
collection process.
- Awareness campaigns were conducted across departments to explain the significance of proper e-waste
disposal. 
Participation and Collaborations 
- Students and volunteers activelyapproached faculty members and all departments to encourage
contributions.
- Students, faculty, and departments of VIIT donated various forms of e-waste, including non-functional and
semi-broken electronics.
- Many students also brought e-waste from their households, highlighting the impact of the awareness
campaign.
- The event was graced by the presence of members of the Lions Club Pune, who encouraged and motivated
the volunteers. They were felicitated during the drive.

E-Waste Collection Drive 
Organized by NSS VIIT

Grade, ISO 9001: 2015 Certified Institute) 

Impact 
- The drive successfully spread awareness on e-waste management across the VIIT campus.
- Students gained insights into the need for responsible recycling and reducing environmental hazards.
- The collaboration with UBA, Leo Club Pune, and Lions Club Pune strengthened the social outreach and
impact of the initiative. 
Conclusion 
The E-Waste Collection Drive 2025 proved to be a meaningful step towards sustainable practices at VIIT.
With enthusiastic participation from students, faculty, and external collaborators, the event not only
contributed to environmental conservation but also fostered a sense of social responsibility among the
participants. NSS VIIT extends heartfelt gratitude to all volunteers, departments, faculty, the Lions Club
Pune, and the collaborating organizations for their support in making this event a grand success. 
Collection and Outcome 
- Dedicated boxes were placed at the booth for safe collection of e-waste.
- A wide range of non-working and semi-broken electronic items was collected from both within the
institute and households.
- The collected e-waste will be handed over to an authorized recycling vendor to ensure safe and eco-
friendly processing.

chosen considering its relevance in India’s democratic setup, where the debate between traditional ballot

significance of social unity, sustainable rural development, and the power of youth involvement in nation-
building initiatives. 
The event aimed to inspire citizens, students, and youth volunteers to actively participate in community 
welfare, promote sustainable living, and understand the importance of collective responsibility in nation-
building.

Introduction
The NSS Unit of VIIT organized a "One-Hour Cleanliness Drive"as part of the
"Swachhata Hi Seva (SHS)"initiative, with the theme ''Ek Din, Ek Ghanta, Ek Saath".
The aim was to encourage students and faculty to dedicate one hour towards cleaning
their surroundings, thereby spreading the message of a cleaner, healthier environment.
To create awareness about the importance of cleanliness and hygiene. T.o" instill a sense
of social responsibility among students. To actively contribute towards the nationwide
Swachh Bharat Abhiyan campaign. To develop teamwork and leadership qualities among
NSS volunteers.
This initiative resulted in visibly cleaner surroundings and encouraged students to adopt
cle anliness habits in their daily life. The program demonstrated the power of collective
effort and inspired other students to volunteer for similar social initiatives in the future.

Acknowledgment
Activities Conducte
A total of around **50-60 NSS volunteers** participated in the cleanliness drive. Students
assembled at 8:45 AM in front of B Building. After a short briefing about the importance of
cleanliness, participants were divided into groups to cover different areas surrounding the
college. The following activities were carried out: Collection of plastic waste, papers, and
other litter from roadsides and open areas. Segregation of waste into dry and wet
categories for proper disposal. Cleaning of pathways, bus stop area, and college front
entrance. Spreading awareness among passersby about maintaining cleanliness in public
places. All participants showed great enthusiasm and teamwork throughout the event.
The NSS Unit of VIIT sincerely thanks the Management, Principal, Faculty Coordinators,
and all volunteers for their cooperation and participation. Special thanks to the volunteers
who actively took part and made this event a success.
